host_ram.finding: on this run the SAMPLED value came out ABOVE the child's in-scope read, the opposite of the 9.5x undercount the classification lane measured, because the child reads its own memory.peak before it has finished.  A sampled observation therefore bounds only the scope's LIFETIME watermark; it does not bound the in-scope read in either direction.

not_covered: the governed delivery check at the top of df_e1_block.child
any GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES was empty, so the GPU field is UNKNOWN and not zero

envelope.why: the consumer reads the scope record by this declaration alone; it never searches for a field that merely shares a name, at the root or anywhere else

scope.why_inode: a scope NAME can repeat -- systemd builds it from a job name, an epoch second and a pid; a fresh scope is a fresh directory

what_this_is: one real cell, launched through the DEPLOYED crispdm-run into a fresh transient scope with its own MemoryMax and its own reservation, trained by the real df_e1_block.run_cell on a SYNTHETIC panel, and supervised by the real df_cell_scope.supervise.  A mechanism proof, not an experiment: the panel is synthetic, the model is tiny, no quality claim is made.
